name: 学校实验室绿幕桌
reconstruction: colleague's MuJoCo twin g1d_food_sorting (sys01, copied to 5090-2:/root/g1d_sim_assets_20261020): tabletop corners fitted from real wrist/head camera frames in the initial torso frame (bundle/environment_manifest.json); build_scene.py moves them to the chassis frame with the recorded torso yaw and fits a rectangle (PLAN.md)
scale_basis: fitted: robot camera calibration and URDF kinematics of the source twin (camera candidate not qualified); tabletop height from the nominal CAD floor at zero lift; no tape measure

lighting.note: not recorded; ceiling panels copied from real_scene3 (6500 K, 24000), room walls and floor neutral grey

notes: reference/ holds renders of the source twin, not photos; real camera frames are on sys01 (outputs/g1d-real2sim). Table legs, walls and floor colour not observed. Torso yaw at episode start taken as raw motor 12 = torso_Joint (3.8 deg).
